title: transportBench operation
description: The transport-correlation bench, in two parts. VERIFY (always): every registered model of the five transport families — gas viscosity (Chung, ChapmanEnskog), gas thermal conductivity (Eucken, modifiedEucken), gas binary diffusivity (Fuller), liquid viscosity (Andrade, Vogel, chemsepEq101), liquid thermal conductivity (SatoRiedel, chemsepEq16) — plus the shared Wilke phi_ij mixing factor reproduces its own anchor, and the deviation is printed beside the model's validity window, its PRIMARY citation and the KIND of anchor: 'theory' (an identity kinetic theory supplies, such as Eucken's monatomic limit) or 'arithmetic' (the correlation's own closed form at a stated point, or — for ChapmanEnskog — Svehla's 1962 printed viscosity reproduced from his own constants within a tolerance the anchor DECLARES and the bench prints). The kind is printed because the catalogue holds NO measured transport data, so a 0.000 % on an arithmetic anchor proves a transcription and nothing else. COMPARE (optional): every registered gas-viscosity and gas-conductivity model is evaluated for every component of the case at one (T, P), each with its computable window verdict; a component a model cannot price (ChapmanEnskog on a record with no lennardJones block) is LISTED as not evaluable, by reason, never skipped in silence; then the case's declared mixing rules give the mixture mu (Wilke) and k (Wassiljewa / Mason-Saxena) at the declared or equimolar composition, and the spread across models is published per family — a real disagreement where two models could answer, and 0 with a sentence saying a spread over one is not agreement where only one could. The bench never ranks the models.

deviationTolerance.title: Anchor deviation tolerance
deviationTolerance.description: Allowed relative deviation of each model from its own anchor; defaults to 1e-4. Tight on purpose: every anchor here is an exact identity or a literal written to six figures, so the only thing a looser tolerance could admit is a wrong coefficient.

compare.title: Comparison point
compare.description: Optional. Evaluate every registered gas model for every component at one state and publish the per-family spread and the mixture values. Omitting the block leaves only the verification half. Requires the case to declare a gas-viscosity transport model, which feeds the conductivity models and the mixing rules.

T.title: Temperature
T.description: The temperature to compare at; carries a unit (e.g. `373.15 K`).

P.title: Pressure
P.description: The pressure to compare at; carries a unit (e.g. `1 bar`). Only the dilute-gas correlations are registered, so P enters the report and the diffusivity family, not the viscosity or conductivity values.

y.title: Gas composition for the mixing rules
y.description: Optional mole fractions, one per case component in declared order, summing to 1. Omitted, the composition is equimolar and the output says so — announced, never assumed silently.
